name: Kacia Pomona
source: A mysterious beauty out to achieve her goals no matter the cost. Kacia may seem cold on the surface, but her drive and passion for her work shapes her every move, even if her expressions gives nothing away. While she has a lot of influence, she prefers to stay in the shadows perfecting her craft, away from the bustle of the Academy proper. She seems close to Emilio, treating him as a pet of sorts.
